name: agents
description: Agents Hub: see, run and review your own Pi agents through one shared dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: View Hub agents, run on Mac
interface.longDescription: Opens the shared Agents Hub dashboard for agents, recent runs and review items, with local data if the Hub is unreachable. Hub reviews are decided in the hosted Agents Hub panel. Local tool calls run on your Mac in Pi with each agent's sandbox, guard and reviewed memory.
